title: NRRS computability and probe-mapping sensitivity
question: Are all eight genes computable and is the score direction stable to an outcome-blind alternative probe rule?
acceptance_test: 8 of 8 genes mapped; 300 scores finite; main and sensitivity score correlation reported; no outcome-guided probe choice
notes: Main artifact is currently a source-table panel; presentation as a worked example could use a compact mapping and agreement plot.

title: GSE62254 reconstructed NRRS overall survival
question: Does the explicit reconstructed NRRS reproduce the anchor's worse-survival direction?
acceptance_test: 300 unique patients; 152 events; balanced groups; HR and CI from source table; high-risk HR greater than 1; plot generated noninteractively
notes: Observed high-vs-low HR 1.529 and log-rank p 0.00906; this is not independent validation.
